target.title: fix: normalize unsupported Anthropic inline images
target.body:
Closes #102323

## Summary

- normalize unsupported Anthropic inline image MIME types at the payload boundary instead of forwarding `image/heic` / `image/tiff` verbatim
- keep `@openclaw/ai` package-independent by routing packaged provider normalization through the AI transport host port, with OpenClaw core injecting the shared `src/media/anthropic-inline-images.ts` implementation
- reuse the same normalization path for the packaged Anthropic provider and the custom Anthropic transport
- add regressions for user-image, tool-result image, and text-only/non-vision paths so dropped images are not decoded before filtering

## Verification

- `git diff --check upstream/live-main...HEAD`
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check packages/ai/src/host.ts packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.test.ts src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.test.ts src/llm/ai-transport-host.ts src/media/anthropic-inline-images.ts src/media/image-ops.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.test.ts src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.test.ts`
- `pnpm build`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/live-main`
- `node --import tsx /private/tmp/openclaw-102323-proof-current.ts`

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: Anthropic user-image and tool-result payloads no longer send unsupported `image/heic` / `image/tiff` media types verbatim; they normalize to `image/jpeg` before the request leaves OpenClaw.
Real environment tested: ran the real `streamAnthropic()` packaged provider from `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` with OpenClaw's AI transport host wiring, plus the real `createAnthropicMessagesTransportStreamFn()` custom transport, against a local `127.0.0.1` loopback Anthropic-compatible capture server that recorded outbound `/v1/messages` payloads and returned Anthropic-style SSE responses.
Exact steps or command run after this patch: `node --import tsx /private/tmp/openclaw-102323-proof-current.ts`
Evidence after fix:
```json
{
  "captured": [
    { "caseId": "packaged-user-heic", "mediaType": "image/jpeg" },
    { "caseId": "packaged-tool-tiff", "mediaType": "image/jpeg" },
    { "caseId": "transport-user-heic", "mediaType": "image/jpeg" }
  ],
  "packagedResult": { "stopReason": "stop", "errorMessage": "" },
  "packagedToolResult": { "stopReason": "stop", "errorMessage": "" },
  "transportResult": { "stopReason": "stop", "errorMessage": "" }
}
```
Observed result after fix: the packaged Anthropic provider sends both HEIC user images and TIFF tool-result images as `image/jpeg`, and the custom Anthropic transport sends HEIC user images as `image/jpeg`; all three requests completed successfully through the real OpenClaw payload builders.
What was not tested: live `api.anthropic.com` was not called; the proof swaps only the remote endpoint for a loopback capture server, and it does not exercise the wider upstream session/image ingestion paths beyond these Anthropic request builders.
